question: What proportional measure is prescribed for the spikes in this construction?
premises: A larger measure is taken as reference
One part of that measure is selected
This part defines the measure of the spikes
inference: One part of the great measures is prescribed as the measure for the spikes.
uncertainties: The reference set of mahatām is not fully specified in this verse
plain_english: One part of the great measures is prescribed as the measure for the spikes.
